## What and why

Describe the change, the contract it implements or the failure mode it fixes.
Link relevant public issues (not private security reports).

## Validation

- [ ] Regression tests or an explanation of why tests do not apply
- [ ] Relevant Release/Debug, sanitizer and tracked builds
- [ ] Formatting, static analysis, forbidden scan and coverage
- [ ] Documentation, compiled snippets and consumers where affected
- [ ] Like-for-like benchmark results for performance-sensitive changes
- [ ] Design/ordering and public prior-art notes updated where applicable
- [ ] Commits signed off with `git commit -s` (DCO), under MIT

List exact commands/results, configurations not tested and remaining concerns.
